name: heydev
description: Spoken notifications for Claude Code: hear when Claude finishes a task or needs your attention, with a one-line summary Claude writes itself. English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German and Italian. Local text-to-speech with Piper, no API keys.

nombre.title: What should it call you?
nombre.description: The name each notification starts with, e.g. "Gastón, I'm done in online store". Leave empty to use the first name of your system account (none on Windows); a dash (-) says no name.

idioma.title: Language
idioma.description: Language for the phrases, the summary and the default voice: en, es, pt, fr, de or it. Leave empty to use your system language.

voz.title: Voice (optional)
voz.description: Any voice from the Piper catalogue, e.g. en_GB-alba-medium or es_MX-claude-high. Leave empty for the default voice of your language.
